content: Ṣāʾin al-Dīn says that before he left for [Herat (?)] (the question mark is MK's) he met in Isfahan the “ringleaders of depravity and sedition” whose anarchic activities had cast turbulence into the world, addressed them as he had the Sufi masters, and that the meeting degenerated into his recrimination and their brazenness; he adds that 'this episode is well-known'.
